How complete and accurate are AI tools to find research papers?

Thousands of scientists around the globe are trying out new tools every day. But it’s difficult to know how complete and accurate they are. In the spirit of open science, I am sharing the results of a rare case where we do know. And the news is not so good.

#AI #aiagents #LitRev #litreview #replication
